installation_absent.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): No MuMu installation root was found (from the configured folder, the running process, the uninstall registry or vendor enumeration).

installation_ambiguous.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): More than one MuMu installation root was found and none was selected explicitly.

shared_adb_multiple_dll_versions.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): The configured adb is MuMu's shared adb and the installation holds more than one Nemu capture DLL version, so no DLL can be chosen without an explicit one.

configured_adb_identity_unrecognized.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): The configured adb does not identify the selected MuMu installation root, so adb and Nemu capture cannot share one installation identity.

root_mismatch.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): A resolved backend file (adb, capture DLL) belongs to another MuMu installation root than the selected one.

dll_outside_root.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): The configured Nemu capture DLL lies outside the selected MuMu installation root.

dll_version_missing.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): No Nemu capture DLL matches the MuMu version folder (nx_device/<version>) of the adb or the running executable.

version_mismatch.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): The adb or the running MuMu executable and the Nemu capture DLL belong to different MuMu version folders.

candidate_absent.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): The selected MuMu installation holds no candidate file for a backend file (adb, capture DLL, MuMuManager).

candidate_outside_root.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): A backend file candidate resolved outside the selected MuMu installation root.

running_executable_topology_invalid.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): The selected running MuMu executable's path does not identify an installation root.

running_version_missing.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): The selected running MuMu executable's path has no MuMu version folder (nx_device/<version>).

target_identity_unavailable.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): No MuMu instance id can be derived for the target instance from its serial.

target_identity_invalid.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): The target instance's explicit MuMu instance id is invalid.

target_identity_mismatch.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): The instance id the target serial implies and the explicit MuMu instance id differ.

target_process_absent.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): No running MuMu device process matches the target instance.

target_process_ambiguous.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): More than one running MuMu device process matches the target instance.

target_executable_missing.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): The running MuMu device process of the target instance has no executable path.

capture_identity_uncoordinated.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): Nemu capture has no MuMu installation identity coordinated with the target and its adb.

provider_version_below_minimum.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): MuMuManager version is below the Runtime's minimum supported MuMuManager version.

provider_version_unparseable.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): MuMuManager version did not produce a four-part numeric version.

registry_source_unavailable.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): The Windows uninstall registry, a MuMu installation source, cannot be read on this platform.

registry_entry_invalid.description: A MuMu resolution step refused (NemuResolutionReason): A MuMuPlayer uninstall registry entry carries no usable install location or an unsupported value type.

scrcpy_server_digest_mismatch.description: #402 RD-3: the scrcpy server the executable carries does not match the SHA-256 pinned in scripts/windows-tools/windows-tool-sources.v1.json, or the build embedded none; the scrcpy capture backend does not open. A damaged or incomplete installation.

scrcpy_server_start_failed.description: #402 RD-3: the scrcpy capture backend could not start: pushing the server, the adb forward, starting the server, connecting to it, its stream header or its first frame failed within the start timeout. The open fails as capture_backend_open_failed.

scrcpy_stream_ended.description: #402 RD-3: the scrcpy video stream stopped: the server exited, the socket closed, a packet was malformed or H.264 decoding failed. No frame is delivered from a stream that ended; the capture fails instead of falling back to another backend.

scrcpy_video_size_mismatch.description: #402 RD-3: the scrcpy stream's video size is not the unscaled size requested (the display, or its centred crop to the size alignment), so its frames would be scaled; the stream is refused instead of downsampled.

capture_frame_stale.description: #398 R1 RD-3i: a stream capture backend received no frame encoded after the capture floor (the completion of the last input, or the frame delivered last) within its fresh wait; the step makes no input.

ensure_device.description: Device layer step: confirming that the adb target answers device (adb get-state, with one connect attempt when allowed) before a backend opens or a capture runs.

screen_size.description: Step of the adb shell input backend's connect: reading the screen size.

bounds_conversion.description: Step of the adb shell input backend's connect: turning the screen size into touch bounds.

device_rotation.description: Step of the adb shell input backend's connect: reading the display rotation.

bounds_validate.description: Operation of the adb shell input backend's connect: deriving and validating the touch bounds.

installation_resolve.description: Nemu capture operation: resolving the MuMu installation (root, adb and capture DLL).

capture_identity.description: Nemu capture operation: coordinating the capture's MuMu installation identity with the target and its adb.

target_resolve.description: Nemu capture operation: resolving the running MuMu device process of the target instance.

segmented_swipe.description: Input operation: a segmented swipe; the capability check refuses it when the selected input backend does not support it.

rotation_resolve.description: Operation of the adb shell input backend's connect that the device error's diagnostic context names when the display rotation cannot be resolved.
